skills.name: babysit-pr
skills.short_description: Monitor a PR through current CI and review feedback
skills.description: Monitor, watch, or babysit a PR through CI and review. Only when monitoring is requested.

skills.name: council
skills.short_description: Review with explicitly requested cross-provider delegates
skills.description: Use for an explicit council request: three read-only reviewers from different providers. Never automatic delegation.

skills.name: file-pr
skills.short_description: File a problem-first PR at the requested endpoint
skills.description: File or update a concise, problem-first PR through the existing publication workflow. Preserve requested draft state.

skills.name: full-send
skills.short_description: Author delivery preset through an authorized merge
skills.description: Use the existing full-send owner; retain its endpoint and permission rules.

skills.name: full-stop
skills.short_description: Deliver verified PR readiness without merging
skills.description: Use when the user requests full stop: delivery through verified readiness, never merge. Earlier narrower stops win.

skills.name: leaving-pr-comments
skills.short_description: Post concise GitHub comments with verified attribution
skills.description: Use before posting GitHub PR comments, reviews, or replies on the user's behalf. Loading grants no posting permission.

skills.name: modernize
skills.short_description: Reassess and safely refresh an older PR
skills.description: Use when asked to modernize or rebase an older PR. Assess whether its goal remains useful before updating the owned branch.

skills.name: sol-loop
skills.short_description: Run an explicitly requested bounded Sol review loop
skills.description: Use for an explicit sol loop request: bounded read-only GPT Sol review rounds. Never automatic delegation.

skills.name: takeover
skills.short_description: Finish inherited work while preserving contributor credit
skills.description: Use when asked to take over a PR, branch, or agent thread. Preserve authorship and the requested delivery endpoint.
